topic: Day 123 — reel — Fear of failing and fear of being seen failing are different fears
text:
It's not
the failure.
It's being
[seen] failing.
caption:
Separate the two and the fear gets a lot smaller. Visibility is a much more manageable problem than eliminating risk.

Follow for one of these a day.
